files.name: Setup
files.source:
✦ Your Glowcap app is ready


Scan with your phone's camera
or open this link on your phone
Android: it opens in Chrome → tap ⋮ → Install app (or Add to Home screen).
iPhone: open it in Safari → Share ⬆ → Add to Home Screen.
Xiaomi, Redmi or POCO? First allow Chrome to add icons: Settings → Apps → Chrome → Other permissions → Home screen shortcuts → Allow.
Use Chrome (Android) or Safari (iPhone). Some browsers, like Brave, block the app.
Keep this link private: it opens your own Glowcap. Lost it? Open this window again any time.

✦ One quick setting first

1Turn on one Google setting (only once)
It lets your sheet create your app for you. It's your own setting and only affects your own account.
Open the setting ↗
On that page, switch Google Apps Script API to On.
Check that the page is signed in as (your picture in the top right). If it shows a different account, click your picture and switch to that one.
2Come back and choose ✦ Glowcap → Set up my phone app again.
Your app is created in about 10 seconds and its QR code appears here.
Just switched it on? Google can take a minute to notice. Wait a moment, then try again.

✦ That didn't work this time

Wait a minute, then choose ✦ Glowcap → Set up my phone app again. Still stuck? Send us a message on Etsy with the text above. We're happy to help.
